name: Deathguard Burgess
summary: In Brill, Deathguard Burgess keeps watch over the town for the Forsaken. He guards the settlement and points travelers toward the services they need.

sections.title: A Watchman in Brill
sections.body: North of the Undercity, Deathguard Burgess guards Brill against the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade. Like other Deathguards in Tirisfal Glades, he guides arriving Forsaken to local tradesfolk, class trainers, and civic services, helping keep the vulnerable outpost running.

faq.answer: Deathguard Burgess guards Brill for the Forsaken. He helps keep order and directs visitors to local trainers and points of interest.

faq.q: What role do the Deathguards serve in Brill?
faq.answer: In Brill, the Deathguards protect the Forsaken from the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade, and keep civil order.
Yes. Ask Burgess where to find class trainers, the local inn, profession masters, and other essential facilities in Brill.

angles.text: As a newly awoken Forsaken leaving Deathknell, you can get your first bearings in Lordaeron from guards like Burgess in Brill.
As a Horde ally visiting from Kalimdor, you can ask Burgess for directions around Brill when you need supplies or a place to rest at the inn.
